title: Figure 39: contour plot of acoustic pressure magnitude, radiating sphere EPW=25
description: ANSYS 12.1 contour plot of the magnitude of pressure (Pa) for 1,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water, labeled 'Uniformly Radiating Sphere, EPW=25.' Pressure magnitude decays radially from the source corner; legend 53.6 to 2723 Pa. From the BAASS underwater acoustics capability demonstration.
